title: A Tradition of Their Own
title_ja: 二人だけの新しい習慣
fact_notes: 人物・状況・会話・結果は架空の教材例。実在の統計や研究結果ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: When Sara and Ben got married, they moved to a small apartment.
sentences.ja: サラとベンは結婚したとき、小さなアパートに引っ越した。

sentences.en: Both of them enjoyed spending holidays with their families.
sentences.ja: 二人とも休暇を家族と過ごすのが好きだった。

sentences.en: However, their families lived in two different towns far apart.
sentences.ja: しかし、二人の家族は離れた別々の町に住んでいた。

sentences.en: Their first winter holiday together was approaching quickly.
sentences.ja: 結婚後初めて一緒に過ごす冬休みが迫っていた。

sentences.en: Sara usually celebrated the holiday with a large family dinner.
sentences.ja: サラはふだん大勢の家族との夕食で休暇を祝った。

sentences.en: Ben's family preferred a quiet morning followed by a long walk.
sentences.ja: ベンの家族は静かな朝を過ごした後、長い散歩をすることを好んだ。

sentences.en: Each person hoped to continue the tradition they knew best.
sentences.ja: それぞれが自分に最もなじみのある習慣を続けたいと思っていた。

sentences.en: Neither wanted the other to feel that their family mattered less.
sentences.ja: どちらも相手の家族の大切さが劣ると感じさせたくなかった。

sentences.en: At first, they tried to include everything in a single day.
sentences.ja: 最初はすべてを1日に詰め込もうとした。

sentences.en: The schedule required several hours of travel between the two towns.
sentences.ja: その予定では二つの町の間を数時間移動する必要があった。

sentences.en: They soon realized that they would have little time to relax anywhere.
sentences.ja: どこでもゆっくりする時間がほとんどなくなるとすぐに気づいた。

sentences.en: Instead of choosing one family over the other, they discussed new possibilities.
sentences.ja: 一方の家族を優先する代わりに、新しい可能性を話し合った。

sentences.en: They agreed to visit Sara's family on the first day of the holiday.
sentences.ja: 休暇の初日にサラの家族を訪ねることに合意した。

sentences.en: They would spend the following day with Ben's family.
sentences.ja: その翌日はベンの家族と過ごすことにした。

sentences.en: On the final evening, they planned to cook a special meal at home.
sentences.ja: 最後の夜には自宅で特別な食事を作る計画を立てた。

sentences.en: They explained their decision to both families before the holiday began.
sentences.ja: 休暇が始まる前に両方の家族に決定を説明した。

sentences.en: Afterward, Sara and Ben agreed that the holiday had felt surprisingly peaceful.
sentences.ja: その後、二人は休暇が驚くほど穏やかだったと感じた。

sentences.en: They had enjoyed old traditions without giving up their own time together.
sentences.ja: 昔からの習慣を楽しみつつ、二人だけの時間も手放さずに済んだ。

sentences.en: Their families suggested keeping the new arrangement the following year.
sentences.ja: 家族たちは翌年も新しい取り決めを続けることを提案した。

sentences.en: The couple learned that respect for the past can leave room for something new.
sentences.ja: 二人は過去への敬意が新しいものを生み出す余地を残せると学んだ。

questions.prompt: What happened when Sara and Ben got married?
options: They moved to a small apartment.
questions.explanation_ja: 小さなアパートに引っ越した。

questions.prompt: What was Sara's usual holiday tradition?
questions.explanation_ja: 大勢の家族で夕食を取ること。

options: A quiet morning and a long walk.
questions.explanation_ja: 静かな朝の後に長い散歩を好んだ。

questions.prompt: Why did the first schedule seem unsuitable?
options: The families lived in the same apartment.
It left too little time to rest.
questions.explanation_ja: 移動に時間がかかり、くつろぐ時間が不足した。

questions.prompt: When did they plan to visit Sara's family?
options: On the first day of the holiday.
questions.explanation_ja: 休暇の初日に訪問する。

questions.prompt: How did they plan to spend the final evening?
options: Cooking a special meal at home.
Inviting both families to a hotel.
questions.explanation_ja: 自宅で特別な食事を作る。
話し合って決めた取り決め。

questions.prompt: How did the holiday feel to the couple?
questions.explanation_ja: 驚くほど穏やかだった。

questions.prompt: Why did they discuss a new schedule instead of choosing one family?
options: They wanted to respect both families while making their own time.
They wanted to end all family traditions.
They did not enjoy visiting either family.
questions.explanation_ja: 双方を尊重し、二人だけの時間も確保しようとした。

options: Couples must follow only one family's customs.
Every family should celebrate holidays in the same way.
People can respect existing customs while creating new ones together.
The best way to celebrate is to travel all day.
questions.explanation_ja: 古い習慣を尊重しつつ新しい習慣を作れる。

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 二つの家族は離れた場所に住んでいた。

paraphrases.source: They soon realized that they would have little time to relax anywhere.
paraphrases.rewrite: They quickly understood that they would hardly have a chance to rest.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: ゆっくりする機会がほとんどないと気づいた。

paraphrases.source: They explained their decision to both families before the holiday began.

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 休暇前に双方へ決定を伝えた。

paraphrases.source: The couple learned that respect for the past can leave room for something new.
paraphrases.rewrite: They realized that honoring old customs does not prevent them from making new ones.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 以前の習慣を尊重しても新たな習慣は作れる。
